candidates: app/controllers/application_controller.rb:159 - Fallback locales are only loaded in the controller `set_locale`, not wherever translations are looked up.. `translate` in translate_accelerator only lazy-loads `config.locale`. The fallback chain (site default locale, then `:en`) gets loaded only by `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` in `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Code that sets `I18n.locale` somewhere else never loads that chain, for example Sidekiq jobs, mailers, rake tasks, or anything that translates before this before_action runs. In those places a key missing from the user's locale returns "translation missing" instead of the fallback, and the LRU cache in `translate` then keeps that wrong result. Fix: load the fallback locales inside `translate` itself, e.g. `I18n.fallbacks[config.locale].each { |l| ensure_loaded!(l) }` instead of loading only `config.locale`.

config/initializers/i18n.rb:17 - The fallback chain depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but the translate cache key doesn't include it.. The fallback list is built from `SiteSetting.default_locale` each time it is read. The translate accelerator caches results under `"#{key}#{config.locale}#{backend.object_id}"`, which leaves the fallback chain out. Suppose a user's locale is missing a key and the value came from the site default locale. If an admin then changes `default_locale`, the cache keeps returning the old locale's string until the entry is evicted or the process restarts. Fix: add the default locale (or the whole fallback chain) to the cache key, or clear `@cache` when `default_locale` changes.
